scope: Read-only before/after collector snapshots; the after window validates the first deployed starvation fix. Any later exact-phase boundary change needs its own deployment verification.
limitations: All target/store/SKU/account/owner identifiers are replaced by stable report-local group numbers.
Request timestamps are scheduler dispatch times; successful-result timestamps include the shared upstream-outcome transaction. They are not raw HTTP-start or per-target durable sample timestamps.
A last-timestamp span across multiple new requests is not one sample interval. Exact single intervals are reported only when the respective cumulative counter grows by exactly one.
Window means use differences in scheduler cumulative count/sumMs, not endpoint spans divided by the number of polling files. No p95 is reconstructed from aggregate counters or snapshot gaps.
The inherited lifetime maxMs cannot determine the maximum interval within this after window; it is deliberately excluded.
The transition interval includes the deployment gap and recovery from old stale groups, so it is separated from the steady after window.
Healthy means the saved-success age passes the configured threshold, not that every target was sampled exactly once per minute or that notification delivery succeeded.
